purpose: Sanity guardrails for long simulation runs; not ground-truth realism targets.
hard_invariants: same model hash + same sim version + same seed must reproduce exactly
no NaN or Inf in model outputs
currency values must be finite and non-negative where domain rules require it
no player may appear for two clubs simultaneously
lineups must obey project position/availability rules
model inference must not consume an uncontrolled random source

distribution_checks.rule: compare candidate vs baseline and historical reference; flag large unexplained shifts
compare candidate vs baseline and historical reference
